title: FCMO Proof Spine Project Receipt v0.3
description: Evidence-only boundary emitted by an FCMO project for local or federated Proof Spine evaluation. Project semantics remain project-owned; this schema carries observations and provenance, never proof-contract authority.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository identity. Federation compares this identity case-insensitively and requires the reviewed proof contract to bind every participating project id to its repository.

max_age_hours.description: Optional producer-side upper bound. A reviewed Proof Spine contract may impose a stricter maximum; this field can tighten but never widen that accepted lifetime.

valid_until.description: Optional producer-side expiry. Contract-owned receipt/evidence freshness may expire the evidence earlier.

$comment: Footnote: evidence producers may carry rich project-local metadata, but mission/claims/gates are forbidden so a producer cannot self-ratify the contract that evaluates it. Cross-project causal equivalence also belongs in the reviewed proofspec, never in runtime evidence, so producers cannot self-award independence or correlation. Producer max_age_hours/valid_until are only local upper bounds: reviewed contract freshness owns the maximum accepted lifetime and may tighten them. Regenerating a receipt must not be treated as refreshing an older underlying observation. Runtime validation also requires any evidence.observed_at to be no later than the enclosing receipt observed_at. Federation membership is contract-closed: receipt identity alone never self-enrolls a project.
